encoding: For the seven gzip logical names, artifact SHA/size binds compressed logical bytes. Read artifact_store.open_artifact then gzip-decode exactly once; decompressed state-stream hashes are separately sealed. Reject ambiguous stored forms.

native_envelope.all_json: Strict JSON: reject duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity, YAML-only content. manifest.yaml contains a complete nested strict JSON run, with actual plan/trial/launch/environment/command/clock facts. The unchanged native complete_manifest schema-valid early return preserves its exact bytes. Test the actual helper route before freeze. Fixtures with a format-only plan use fixture_only:true and approved_by:null; this supplies test facts only and grants no scientific authority. Exact launched interpreter argv comes from sys.orig_argv, including flags.
native_envelope.publication: Checker RC0 means structural complete outputs only; scientific_validity remains not_assessed; independent mathematical validation is still required.
native_envelope.source: tools/experiment_execution.py complete_manifest schema-valid early return; no core change or fallback YAML parser

native_stdout: C++ includes curve_index in each canonical row. Exact stdout bytes retained once in states.jsonl.gz; census.stdout.log stores per-invocation offsets/linecounts/bytes/SHA references only.
outer_termination: process.json.gz records driver RC null/pending supervisor exit honestly. Later immutable execution-receipt.json owns actual driver/checker returncodes and manifest action. Checker runs before that receipt exists.
partial_policy: Any caught implementation/source/process failure retains actual source before/after, process data with unknown driver exit pending supervisor, partial.json, incomplete export listing present/missing members, and raw-result complete:false. No missing-data density or q=0 is emitted. Uncatchable termination leaves missing required artifacts and fails closed.
producer_mode: Exactly one census mode; no fixtures mode or regression mode trial. controls.json/regression.json.gz status not_run are truthful placeholders, not performed checks or guaranteed later producer trials. Their fixed reason strings do not create an extra trial.
report_plan: No guessed run-RUN report is a runtime artifact. After actual launch timestamp is known, root allocates and commits a separate unclaimed report/publication handoff with exact UTC path and one archive owner before any report writes. Composition fixed report/graph/PDF remains separately owned. No raw run output or receipt is relabeled.

root_publication.later_store_writer: Root only after actual trial and release; modern content-addressed identity pointers for exact existing gzip bytes, one supported stored form/logical artifact; fullGET size/SHA required. No native receipt edits.

scientific_validity: not_assessed by producer; complete_output_checked is structural only. Exact q/reference qualify only after independent full new/retained reconciliation and known-false controls.

status_serialization_contract.basis: Statement-only serialization definition transcribed from original frozen semantics, for independent validator phase2 without producer harness reads. Mathematical flags/counts already sealed remain unchanged; literal equivalence remains pending actual comparison.

definitions: Count erasures e and capped=(e>erasure_cap). If capped, word list is empty, expected_word_count=word_count=0, M=0, zero_candidate_checks=0; inversion/cap work still occurs.
If not capped, enumerate all erasure assignments and <=radius defined-bit flips. Retain every word, legality and public checks. M excludes zero and counts distinct converted nonzero candidates.
recoveries are the converted scalars from words where both public checks pass; recovered_scalars is sorted distinct recoveries. scalar is the first recovery in enumeration order, or null.
decoder_cell.final_override: For radius=0 AND erasure_cap=0, replace only cell.status with original strict attempt.status. Preserve capped, erasures, expected_word_count, word_count, list, M, zero checks, scalar/recovered_scalars and all other decoder fields. Therefore a capped t0.e0 cell with any erasure has status UNDEFINED from strict attempt, not CAPPED_ERASURES. Other capped cells retain CAPPED_ERASURES.
decoder_cell.no_reason_field: Original decoder-cell records do not define an additional reason field.

provisional_status_precedence.when: otherwise, words nonempty and every word status is EMPTY_INTERVAL

decoder_word.definitions: For each enumerated completion V, k=ceil(r*V/D). legal iff 0<=k<r AND D*k<r*(V+1). Convert x and evaluate BOTH public checks for every legal word, including zero; illegal words have candidate_scalar null and both checks null. candidate_scalar_prime retains rounded k for every word.
decoder_word.no_reason_field: Original decoder-word records do not define an additional reason field.

status_serialization_contract.sensitivity_obligation: On mathematically valid inputs the two equations are equivalent, so deleting one check cannot be detected solely by a valid-input success count. Independent controls must deliberately use an inconsistent conversion/base/target/scalar/sign fixture and check each equation separately, while retaining rejection of inconsistent public input. Do not claim separate-check sensitivity from equivalent valid equations.

definitions: fully_defined is true exactly when every L query has status BIT. On each query use its bit if BIT, otherwise use zero for the internal binary accumulation and collect its reason.
D=2^L. If fully_defined, V is the MSB-first accumulated word, lower=r*V, upper=r*(V+1), k=ceil(lower/D). Otherwise candidate_scalar_prime is null.
nonempty is fully_defined AND k<r AND D*k<upper. k is nonnegative for legal binary V.
inverse_b is computed even when undefined or interval-empty. candidate_scalar remains null and both public checks remain null unless nonempty.
When nonempty, x=(a*inverse_b mod r)*k mod r. Evaluate both [k]P=R and [x]G=Q unconditionally, including x=0 and known failures.
recovered is nonempty AND transformed_check AND original_check.

serialized_fields.candidate_scalar: x if nonempty, including rejected zero; null otherwise
serialized_fields.candidate_scalar_prime: k if fully_defined, including an empty-interval candidate; null otherwise
serialized_fields.scalar: x only if recovered; null otherwise
serialized_fields.scalar_prime: k only if recovered; null otherwise

status_precedence.reason: Comma-joined sorted distinct query reason strings.
